fr.recommendations:
• Mark the single access point entrance with reflective building address signage visible from both directions of approach.
• Post a site map at the access point showing the locations of both structures, the drive aisle route, and any dead-end areas.
• Keep the internal drive aisle clear of parked vehicles to allow emergency vehicles to reach both the main building and the detached building without obstruction.
• Identify and mark a dedicated emergency vehicle staging area within the parking area that remains clear at all times.
• Mark the detached building with a visible address or unit identifier so responders can distinguish it from the main building during an emergency.
• Trim dense vegetation along the drive aisle to maintain clear sightlines and overhead clearance for emergency vehicles traveling between structures.
• Keep walkway connections between the main building and detached building clear to allow responder foot movement between structures.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster to reduce the concentration of branches and foliage in that area.
• Remove any dead branches, limbs, or debris from beneath scattered trees near buildings.
• Clear vegetation that is in direct contact with or growing against building walls.
• Keep the rear of the building accessible by removing any vegetation or debris that limits movement along that side.
• Maintain the open paved areas clear of encroaching vegetation to preserve separation between landscaping and buildings.
